text: Session summary: (1) Branch audit across BrassLedger/Copperfin at rhamenator's request found 35 stale/dead branches on this repo; deleted 31 after verifying byte-identical or line-by-line-superset content against their actual merge targets (agent/v1-curval and agent/v1-key-tagcount weren't identical trees but every diff line was the -dco variant extending, not replacing, the original). Left mac-codex/preserved-149470da2 alone (deliberate archive). (2) codex/reviewer-workspace-consolidation's log.jsonl payload surfaced that the Windows trailing-dot/trailing-space path-alias gap codex held across PRs #5006-#5012 (2026-08-14/15) was never actually fixed -- RQ-CF-AGENT-009/010/012 are still recorded 'defined' despite codex's exact-head counter-evidence, and none of the five *-windows-path-alias* regression harnesses codex named were ever added anywhere. Fixed in PR #5399 (agent/v1-windows-path-alias-rejection): path_has_windows_alias_prone_component() added to workspace_agent_target_containment.cpp, workspace_agent_process_containment.cpp, and workspace_agent_environment.cpp (Windows-only, no-op on POSIX), regression coverage added to the existing test files per codex's own review comments on that PR (also caught that WorkspaceAgentFileTargetBoundary::create() had its own bespoke root validation bypassing the shared check -- fixed). RQ-CF-AGENT-011/015/017/019/023/029 derive from the corrected requirements and may need the same traceability-evidence correction; not attempted, flagged in agent-handoff.md. (3) Also opened PR #5398 (agent/v1-dbf-header-fuzzing): new optional libFuzzer harness for parse_dbf_header, reviving the fuzzing coverage from the original 2026-08-08 agent/v1-dbf-header-fuzzing branch that was lost when codex handed the task off after an OpenAI content-review block (see docs/65-dbf-header-parser-fuzzing.md). codex's PR review on #5398 caught a real corpus-reset bug (fixed) before I found it myself -- fast, useful review. Both PRs pending final Windows CI as of this message; merging once green. Full detail in agent-handoff.md under 'Windows trailing-dot/trailing-space path-alias rejection' and docs/65-dbf-header-parser-fuzzing.md.
